extracted.intended_audience: local diners and visitors seeking the best Korean restaurants in Phoenix (foodies, casual readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A local food blog listicle reviewing and ranking Korean restaurants in Phoenix, with per-restaurant summaries, contact info, hours, and highlights to help readers choose where to eat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food quality / flavor
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluates how flavorful and well-seasoned the dishes are (e.g., 'Each dish was bursting with flavor', 'spicy pork belly was simply out of this world').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page emphasizes bold, well-balanced flavors and specific standout dishes (bibimbap, bulgogi, tteokbokki). Mentions 'fantastic food' and repeated phrases like 'delicious' and 'mouthwatering' as markers of high food quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freshness of ingredients
rubrics_metrics.description: Assesses ingredient freshness and how that affects taste ('The ingredients were clearly fresh and of the highest quality').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer cites fresh ingredients as elevating every bite; freshness is used as evidence for recommending a place.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation / plating
rubrics_metrics.description: Considers visual presentation of dishes ('impeccably presented').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good plating is noted as part of an elevated dining experience; reviewer links presentation to overall impression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Menu variety and signature dishes
rubrics_metrics.description: Extent and diversity of menu offerings and presence of standout or signature items (bibimbap, bulgogi, spicy pork belly, tofu soup, corn dogs, bingsu, BBQ in a cup).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list cites both classic and novel items; variety and unique menu concepts (fusion items, desserts) are used to recommend restaurants for different preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portion size / value (generous portions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether portions satisfy hunger and represent good value ('generous portions', 'getting your money's worth').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer explicitly calls out generous portions and leftover value as positives; 'reasonable prices' also cited elsewhere as part of value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service / staff friendliness and attentiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality of service, staff helpfulness, and their knowledge ('staff greeted me with warm smiles', 'attentive service', 'staff took their time to explain the menu').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positive, knowledgeable, and attentive staff are repeatedly cited as reasons to recommend a restaurant; willingness to explain menu items is highlighted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere / vibe
rubrics_metrics.description: The restaurant's ambiance and energy ('vibrant and lively atmosphere', 'lively Korean music', 'playful yet professional ambiance', 'buzzing').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ambiance is used to transport the diner (e.g., to Seoul) or create a fun experience; matching atmosphere to the dining occasion (casual, lively, date-night) is advised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cleanliness / hygiene
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards of cleanliness in dining areas and restrooms ('tables, floors, and even the bathrooms were impeccably maintained').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Impeccable cleanliness is singled out as an important positive factor affecting the overall dining experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special features / entertainment and amenities
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence of add-ons like karaoke rooms, private rooms, DIY grilling at the table, unique service elements (e.g., 'BBQ in a cup').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amenities that add entertainment or novelty (karaoke, do-it-yourself grilling, private rooms) are considered differentiators and recurring reasons people choose a venue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authenticity vs. playful/modern twists
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree to which the restaurant serves authentic Korean flavors versus playful or modern reinterpretations ('authentic flavors', 'playful twist on traditional Korean cuisine').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer values both authenticity and creative reinterpretation depending on dining goals; authenticity for traditionalists, playful twists for novelty-seekers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beverage selection (soju and others)
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability and quality of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages ('Gen Korean BBQ House offers a great selection [of soju]').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beverage options like soju are part of the recommended experience and can enhance social dining; selection quality informs recommendations for evening outings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Banchan policy / side-dish generosity
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality and refill policy of side dishes (noted as 'endlessly refillable banchan').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generous, well-prepared banchan are treated as an important positive attribute of Korean BBQ and communal dining places.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reservation policy and crowding / popularity
rubrics_metrics.description: How busy the place gets and whether reservations are advisable ('making a reservation was a smart move', 'the place gets packed').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer recommends making reservations for popular spots; crowding affects the experience and is a practical consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating hours and accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical information about when the restaurant is open and how accessible it is (detailed open hours for each day).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hours are provided per restaurant and are used to advise readers when to visit; accessibility (location) is also part of the listing metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and listing metadata (address, phone, website)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of address, phone number, and website for each restaurant to enable visits and bookings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article consistently provides address, phone, and sometimes website links as essential elements of a usable restaurant guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price / affordability
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the restaurant offers reasonable prices and represents value ('reasonable prices', 'money's worth').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Price is discussed in conjunction with portion size and quality; 'reasonable prices' and value-for-money reinforce recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attention to detail / overall coherence of the dining experience
rubrics_metrics.description: How well food, service, atmosphere, and extras come together ('attention to detail in both their food and service', 'combination of fantastic food, great atmosphere, and friendly staff').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer uses holistic judgments—when multiple positive criteria align, the restaurant is called a 'must-visit' or 'hidden gem'; attention to detail is cited as elevating a venue into a top recommendation.
